release_objective: Plan three separately authorized V1 phases for the MP3 application, independent local containers and the required release cycle.

phases.objective: Reuse the merged foundation, establish an independent MediaInfo baseline and review fixed-command phase validation.
phases.authority: Planning is authorized now; execute this phase only after its prerequisites and a separate explicit phase instruction.
acceptance_criteria: The merged foundation is reused and the current scoped PR passes meaningful checks without weakening core controls or the owner-only review exception.
The identified sample has actual MediaInfo version, commands, MPEG format and independent count evidence before parser work.
The reviewed bounded adapter runs fixed npm/baseline checks and reports actual failures and tool-environment limitations.
stop_conditions: Stop on missing MediaInfo, absent sample evidence, checksum mismatch, unavailable reviewed executor behavior or failed validation.
End at the scoped PR and evidence report; no parser, application, infrastructure implementation, merge or next phase is authorized.

phases.objective: Implement and validate the standalone TypeScript physical frame counter with independent sample reconciliation.
phases.authority: Planning is authorized now; execute this phase only after its prerequisites and a separate explicit phase instruction.
acceptance_criteria: The pure TypeScript parser and independent known-count fixtures cover headers, per-frame bitrate/padding, tags, payload sync patterns and strict failure cases.
Typecheck, built-in Node tests and real parser build pass, and MediaInfo differences are explicitly reconciled.
No HTTP, UI or container implementation is included.
stop_conditions: Stop on unresolved sample discrepancies, unsupported required inputs, unapproved compatibility reductions or failed checks.
End at the scoped PR and evidence report; do not implement HTTP, UI, containers, merge or advance phases.

phases.objective: Integrate the native API and static UI, independently package both containers and satisfy the required release cycle.
phases.authority: Planning is authorized now; execute this phase only after its prerequisites and a separate explicit phase instruction.
acceptance_criteria: API, accessible UI, exact response/error contracts and actual-byte upload limits pass real integration tests.
Both images build independently and Compose frontend-origin health, above-1-MiB upload, boundary and unavailable-API tests pass.
All Make targets and reproducible instructions work with quoted paths and project-only cleanup.
The release target and policy are resolved before implementation, and all APP-REL-001 through APP-REL-006 have actual authorized deployment, release and recovery evidence before V1 completion.
stop_conditions: Stop on unresolved release target or access, missing evidence, failed checks or a change to fixed architecture.
End implementation at a scoped PR; merge, release publication, deployment and recovery execution require the relevant explicit authorization.
Keep V1 incomplete until application and release criteria are actually verified; no automatic next MVP.
